mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, device_id, device_name, device_type, os, browser, ip, location, login_time, last_active_time, status, trusted, fingerprint FROM user_device WHERE deleted = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY last_active_time DESC

SELECT id, user_id, device_id, device_name, device_type, os, browser, ip, location, login_time, last_active_time, status, trusted, fingerprint FROM user_device WHERE deleted = 0 AND device_id = #{deviceId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, device_id, device_name, device_type, os, browser, ip, location, login_time, last_active_time, status, trusted, fingerprint FROM user_device WHERE deleted = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} AND device_id = #{deviceId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_device WHERE deleted = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND last_active_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)
